text:
Samir P: morning team — I'm on until 09:30 PT. Quick rundown before I head into meetings:
- rolled a small config change to prefetch service at ~06:15 PT; deploy-bot reported success.
- watch prefetch-queue length and prefetch-worker spinups. if queue > 2000 we see autoscale noise.
- KV cache warming job scheduled at 08:00 PT (might bump read latency for ~3m).
If anything odd, page me (@samir) or escalate to eng-oncall.

Oncall Bot: deploy prefetch-config v2.3.1 -> succeeded (06:16:03 PT) :white_check_mark:

Maria G: noted. i'll watch the queue. if it crosses 1200 i'll bump the prefetch parallelism to 8 and report back.

Kevin L: left a small PR to revert a noisy logging change that removed a metric (req_duration). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prefetch/pull/432 — if we start losing request_duration, please revert.

Dena R: heads-up — the KV warming job runs on job-runner-2 and historically causes a short read-latency spike (~150–200ms) for ~3m. i'll add a staggered start (t+30s) if queue shows any instability.

Samir P: action items — Maria: watch queue and bump parallelism if needed. Dena: add stagger to KV warming. Kevin: monitor metrics and revert logging PR if request_duration disappears. I'll keep auto-fallback enabled for prefetch -> model-b tier for the next 48h and set max_instances=4 for burst scaling. No canary for this small config change.

Maria G: 👍 adding a tiny dashboard widget on infra/home for prefetch/qps + cache/read-latency.

Oncall Bot: rota: Samir P assigned primary until 09:30 PT.

Kevin L: quick q — should we temporarily disable burst-scaling during the KV warming window? last time it made worker churn worse.

Samir P: good point. i'd rather keep burst enabled but cap it. i'm applying `max_instances=4` now (kubectl patch snippet):
```
kubectl patch hpa prefetch -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":4}}'
```
I'll post back when that's applied.

Maria G: thanks — i'll log any queue blips in the thread.

Dena R: will add the stagger and push a short note to ops-runbooks about the warming job timing.

Samir P: thanks all. leaving detailed watchlist in the dashboard; will check back at 08:05 PT after the warming job starts.

Maria G: copy, standing by.
